mode: independent actual HTTP handlers and installed SDK CAS; synthetic Twilio GET receipts; no external network, model, SMS or email

checks.name: gate starts closed; verified inquiry is retained without a reply or any proactive send
signature, canonical URL, account, service, number, duplicate parameters and media fail closed
authenticated Message GET must match each signed receipt field and bounded creation time
same-SID races reserve exactly one reply; discarded first response remains delivery unknown and is not replayed
same-SID changed contents are held rather than overwriting consent or generating another response
delayed duplicate finalization cannot downgrade an archived primary reply receipt
STOP wins equal/older START; ordinary messages never remove suppression; newer START grants replies only
repeat distinct stop receipts are retained silently; gate-off stop persistence is still permitted
provider-managed keyword acknowledgments are never duplicated by the application
M&C inquiry never resolves a legacy customer or shared homeowner bridge
private history omits provider references, configured secrets, tax identifiers and common sign-in credentials
only authorized operator sessions can retrieve platform inquiries through the actual management handler
projection failure retains the primary receipt; retries recover STOP and history without a second reply
recent history archives automatically; per-SID fences survive eviction and the daily reply budget renews without clearing STOP
